title: breach_tier
description: The `breach_tier` content kind (megaplan 1.7 and tasks 6-A1, 6-B1): how hard a Breach Protocol is, by the device's security level. `security` is 1 for an ordinary device, 2 for a secure one (device flag bit 2) and 3 for a hardened one (a secure and locked device, a Phase 8 player hack); one file per level, and a datapack file with the same id replaces it. `grid` is the side of the square code grid (5 to 7), `buffer` the number of slots the player may fill (4 to 8), `seconds` the timer, and `daemons_min` and `daemons_max` how many daemon sequences the generator tries to place (1 to 3; it never places one the buffer cannot hold, so a tight buffer may give fewer than the minimum, and every placed daemon is solvable). `firewall` holds exactly three steps, one per Firewall rank 1, 2 and 3 of the defending side's `firewall` implant (rank 0, no implant, changes nothing); each step is added to the base values: the grid grows (never past 7), the buffer, the timer shrink (never below 4 slots and 10 seconds) and the daemon range's upper end may grow by one (never past 3).
